messages:
maria: Heads-up: flagged a high-severity vuln in google.golang.org/grpc (< v1.56.0) from the Go vuln DB. Repro on our batch worker streaming test causing memory leak/OOM. @eng-security please triage.

dependabot: opened PR #312: bump google.golang.org/grpc v1.56.1 -> v1.57.0 in modules: service-api, runtime

jon: Where are we seeing it repro? production or only in CI/stage?

maria: Repro on abc-stage during long-lived client streaming. Logs show repeated goroutine growth; trace attached to the incident. Not in public customer APIs yet but hits internal batch job.

kevin: Also picked up a patch for golang.org/x/oauth2 (token parsing overflow) — low->medium. Separate CVE.

maria: There's also a net/http server read-loop issue (CVE-2026-ZZZZ) fixed in go1.21.8. Some builder images still on 1.21.6.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-101, assigned to @oncall

jon: Proposal: urgent hotpatch for grpc on Dedicated clusters. Plan: pin module to v1.57.0 in all affected services, build new images on go1.21.8, canary rollout to non-customer clusters first.

kevin: For fast mitigation, add a temporary replace in go.mod to force the grpc version across transitive graphs:

```
replace google.golang.org/grpc => google.golang.org/grpc v1.57.0
```

maria: Quick command to create PR: `go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.57.0 && go mod tidy && git add go.mod go.sum && git commit -m "chore(deps): pin grpc v1.57.0 (CVE triage)"`

jon: Add a unit/integration test that simulates streaming close/fail to gate the rollout. Link the test vector to PR description.

kevin: I'll open cross-repo PRs and a backport checklist. Marking P0 for services touching internal batch processing.

maria: Timeline I'm proposing: PRs today -> canary tomorrow morning -> full rollout Friday afternoon. Need SRE rollback playbook updated (old image with goproxy cache + go.mod revert).

dependabot: PR #313: bump golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.2.3 -> v0.3.0

kevin: oauth/jwt patches can ship in same window but lower priority — ensure tests pass, otherwise defer.

maria: Action items: Maria: triage and repro artifacts; Kevin: open PRs and apply replace directives; Jon: canary plan + runbook; @oncall: monitor error budgets and traces during canary.

sre-bot: Deploy started: canary cluster group 'staging-2' - job id deploy-2026-77

oncall: ACK. Watching 5xx and memory use. Alert if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m :eyes:

maria: Also adding an audit note: module version changes recorded to compliance log (KMS key rotations unaffected). Will post links to SBX compliance channel.

jon: After a clean rollout let's create a short remediation recap and tag the CVE entries we observed. If anything flares, we'll open a short postmortem.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
